claim_boundary: This is a lightweight citation-backed pilot using retrieved Semantic Scholar metadata and simple term-overlap scoring. It is stronger than manual descriptors but still not a full citation graph reconstruction, blinded expert review, or proof of long-term SOTA alignment. It filters citations by lexical relevance, but thin or topically broad citation graphs can still produce misleading frontier terms.
